descriptionByLocale.en:
Your field of activity
• You assume overall corporate responsibility for a demanding portfolio of hydropower investments in Switzerland and align it consistently with long-term value enhancement, sustainability and resilience. In boards of directors, power plant companies and industry associations, you represent BKW as a mandate holder and support your colleagues in comparable roles with your experience
• You develop higher-level business and technical strategies for the portfolio, identify optimization potential, opportunities and risks and implement them effectively. You regularly evaluate projects and assets and ensure that they are driven forward in accordance with internal requirements and external developments
• You will assess ambitious investment, expansion and renovation projects and develop the necessary decision-making bases that enable sustainable and well-founded decision-making. A completed university degree in the technical field supplemented by sound business skills from practice or further education
• You bring several years of experience in the energy industry as well as in portfolio, asset or investment management related to renewable energies (hydropower, wind or solar)
• Negotiating knowledge of German is required, ideally supplemented by knowledge of French at a professional level
• Strategic, analytical and entrepreneurial thinking shapes your working method, as well as experience in dealing with internal and external stakeholders at management level
• High personal responsibility, decision-making strength and implementation orientation characterize you, supported by integrity and a clear understanding of sustainable solutions
• You convince with your openness, your motivation to help shape the future and your noticeable enthusiasm for sustainable energy projects Roger Lüönd Head of Asset Hydro roger.lueoend@bkw.ch We do not want any inquiries from personnel service providers. We look forward to your online application. BKW offers its customers internationally complete solutions in the fields of energy, buildings and infrastructure. We employ around 11,500 people. Together we build networks, produce energy, plan and realise energy-efficient buildings and design sustainable living spaces of tomorrow. For this we need you: people with ideas and commitment. Make a valuable contribution to society and our environment with us!
